definition: Dispositional tendency to appraise failure as threatening and to avoid situations where it is possible.
taxonomy: Atkinson motive to avoid failure · Performance Failure Appraisal Inventory (Conroy) · Elliot & Thrash

notes: REPLACES "Thrill & Adventure Seeking" from the starting list: TAS is one of the four SSS-V subscales already summed into C4-1, and physical-adventure risk sits inside DOSPERT recreational (C4-2) — three rows from one scale was too much. Fear of failure is Atkinson's counterpart to the achievement motive and the avoidance side of "risk" the column had no row for. Reads as anxiety's work-face; it is a motive/trait, not a clinical state. Contested placement: could sit under an Emotionality column.

definition: Readiness to drop social and behavioural restraint — partying, drinking, saying what comes.

taxonomy: Zuckerman SSS-V Dis subscale · Sharma et al. disinhibition factor · Patrick triarchic Disinhibition
